rules.law_name: An Act prohibiting algorithmic rent setting
rules.title: Prohibition on algorithmic rent setting
rules.requirement: If enacted, this bill would prohibit algorithmic rent setting in Massachusetts rental housing. The document does not state the operative details, coverage, exemptions, or penalties.
rules.quoted_span: of Cindy F. Friedman and Julian Cyr for legislation to prohibit algorithmic rent setting; and (accompanied by bill, Senate, No. 1016) of Michael O. Moore, Patricia D. Jehlen and James B. Eldridge
